mapper.select: select mn.*, se.*, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, ifnull(sc.selectionCount, 0) as selectionCount, secChange.Ex_State as changeState, secChange.id as changeId, secDelete.Ex_State as deleteState, secDelete.id as deleteId, ifnull(mn.key_expert, sad.key_expert) as keyExpert from Sec_Expert_Audit_Group_Detail mn left join Sec_Expert se on se.Ex_Id = mn.Ex_Id left join Sec_Expert_Audit_Detail sad on sad.Ex_Id = mn.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id left join (select t.Ex_Id, t.year, t.Ex_State, t.id from Sec_Expert_Change t join (select Ex_Id, year, max(Ex_Create_Time) as max_time from Sec_Expert_Change group by Ex_Id, year) m on m.Ex_Id = t.Ex_Id and m.year = t.year and m.max_time = t.Ex_Create_Time) secChange on secChange.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id and secChange.year = se.year left join (select t.* from Sec_Expert_Delete t join (select Ex_Id, year, max(Ex_Create_Time) as max_time from Sec_Expert_Delete group by Ex_Id, year) m on m.Ex_Id = t.Ex_Id and m.year = t.year and m.max_time = t.Ex_Create_Time) secDelete on secDelete.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id and secDelete.year = se.year left join (select ssrd.Ex_Id, count(*) as selectionCount from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl ssrd join Sec_Selection_Record ssr on ssr.Sr_Id = ssrd.Sr_Id and ssr.State = 7 where ssrd.Srd_Attend = 1 group by ssrd.Ex_Id) sc on sc.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id where mn.Sea_id = #{id}
